Type: adjustable metal task lamp
Use: reading and task light; home office, bedroom, living room, on a desk or side table
Style: Scandinavian, industrial, mid-century modern
Materials: matte black metal, light wood accent, white inner shade, built-in USB port
Colors: matte black, light natural wood, white
Shape: angled cone shade with wooden cap on a pivot arm, thin straight pole, round weighted base, slim and compact
Feel: graphic, warm, functional
Goes with: light wood desks, white walls, black accents; Scandinavian or industrial home offices

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Scandinavian Task Lamp, 19"H, Matte Black
product.description: This nifty matte-black table lamp has a slim stem, a hooded shade, and contrasting accents—a modern design with vintage flair. Better yet, it comes with a useful USB port on the base. Talk about stylish and convenient! This table lamp is made out of metal and wood. This lamp comes with a useful USB port. This lamp has a modern design with classic touches that make it neatly blend with any room. 6"W x 6"D x 19"H Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes This lamp comes with a bulb and is rated for indoor use.
